bind.description: Requirements with the same bind name must hold on ONE common resource the source picks.

request_context.description: Condition-key values carried by the technique's own request.

resource.description: Resource ARN / pattern / placeholder the action must cover ('*' = any).

any_of.description: Alternative groups: at least one group must fully hold (with all_of).

include_service_managed.description: Allow service-managed identities (AWS service-linked roles, Google-managed agents, Microsoft first-party service principals) as sources; they are skipped by default because customers cannot act as them.

source_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): the source principal id matches one of the case-insensitive globs.

source_reaches_kind.description: Generic (evaluator, graph post-pass): the source is of that target kind or reaches a node of that kind through the other techniques' edges (fixpoint); the edge takes the weakest confidence of the best chain and the condition source_reaches_<kind>_via_chain.

any_principal_in_scope.description: Entity target covering every principal of the scope where the requirement holds (scope owner / cluster-admin / account admin).

assigned_to_identity_center_group.description: Permission set / user is reachable through an Identity Center group assignment (not collected).

assumable_by_pivot_role.description: Role the pivot role ({pivot}, e.g. a StackSet administration role) can assume: its trust admits the pivot role (or its account) and the pivot's identity policy allows sts:AssumeRole on it (trust naming the pivot ARN in the same account suffices). For StackSets, a new or existing self-managed StackSet route must also reach the target account. The pivot itself is excluded; roles in other accounts are included.

attached_resource_covered_by.description: The resource carrying the target role ({target.attached_resource_arn}) is covered by the action.

attached_to_service.description: Identity is attached to a collected resource of that service (Lambda Role, EC2 instance profile, GCE/GKE service account, Azure resource identity incl. full ARM types). Uncollected attachment inventories fall back to trust/all identities with unknown confidence.

aws_cases_tag_self_grant.description: Reviewed Cases domain tag change unlocking PutCaseEventConfiguration for the source.

aws_challenge_fact.description: Exact externally verified technique/source/target evidence from aws_privesc_challenge_evidence. Missing or incomplete evidence is unresolved; a different source or target never matches.

aws_efs_policy_self_grant.description: Reviewed ClientMount self-grant for the exact EFS file system.

aws_s3_access_grants_self_grant.description: Reviewed exact S3 Access Grants session with new READ permission on a bounded prefix.

aws_s3_policy_self_grant.description: Reviewed exact S3 bucket-policy self-grant for the caller and a bounded object prefix.

aws_secretsmanager_policy_self_grant.description: Reviewed GetSecretValue self-grant for the exact IAM user and secret.

aws_sitewise_portal_self_grant.description: Reviewed SiteWise Monitor portal ADMINISTRATOR grant to the source identity.

codedeploy_group_instance_role_covered_b.description: Target role is the instance role of a CodeDeploy deployment group covered by the action (not collected).

cognito_developer_authenticated_role.description: Target role is the authenticated role of an identity pool with a developer provider, with trust admitting that pool's authenticated Cognito web identity.

cognito_developer_classic_role.description: Target role trusts the authenticated web identity of a developer identity pool whose Basic (Classic) flow is enabled, whether or not it is the pool's default role.

cognito_developer_enable_classic_role.description: Target role trusts a developer identity pool whose Basic (Classic) flow is disabled; the source can enable that flow and mint a developer token for the same pool.

cognito_developer_settable_authenticated.description: Target role can become the authenticated role of a collected developer identity pool and trusts that pool's authenticated web identity; the source must be able to mint a developer token for the same pool.

cognito_user_pool_covered_by.description: Target role is mapped by an identity pool to a user pool covered by the action; dropped when the account's cognito_user_pool inventory is collected and empty, otherwise unknown (identity-pool roles not collected).

cognito_user_pool_group_role_covered_by.description: Target role is the RoleArn of a user-pool group covered by the action; dropped when the account's cognito_user_pool inventory is collected and empty, otherwise unknown (groups not collected).

consumer_input_writable_via.description: The source can write an input ({target.consumer_input_arn}) consumed by the target workload with the action.

ecs_container_instance_role_in_cluster_c.description: Target role is the instance role of an ECS container instance or the task role of a task placed on one (dropped when every cluster has 0 container instances; unknown without container-instance/task inventory).

ecs_task_colocated_with_source_container.description: Value {source.arn}: the source is an EC2 container-instance role and the target task or task-execution role runs (or, without placement facts, may run: unknown) on an EC2 container instance carrying the source's instance profile.

ecs_task_role_on_ec2_capacity.description: Target role is the taskRoleArn of an EC2/EXTERNAL-capable task definition (or of a running EC2 task) in an account whose ECS clusters have registered container instances; dropped when no such definition exists or every cluster has 0 container instances, conditional without task placement, unknown without task-definition inventory.

eks_authentication_mode.description: EKS cluster accessConfig.authenticationMode is one of the values (API, API_AND_CONFIG_MAP, CONFIG_MAP); unknown when not collected.

emr_runtime_role_of_cluster.description: Role trust names an EC2 instance-profile role used by an EMR cluster with a security configuration (runtime roles); unknown without emr_cluster inventory.

exclude_target_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): drop targets whose node id matches one of the globs.

has_instance_profile.description: Role is in at least one instance profile (InstanceProfileList).

has_login_profile.description: IAM user has (true) / lacks (false) a console password (LoginProfile detail).

instance_profile_name_prefix_or_path.description: One of the role's instance profiles has a name starting with the value, or (values starting with '/') a path containing it.

name_prefix.description: Role name (and instance-profile name) starts with the value.

org_member_account.description: Target belongs to an operational organization member account (not the management account); unknown without organization_account.

portfolio_of_target_product_covered_by.description: Target role is the launch-constraint role of a Service Catalog product in a portfolio ({target.portfolio_arn}); unknown without servicecatalog_portfolio inventory.

resource_permission_covers_target.description: The source must also hold this action on the target resource ({target.arn}/{target.email}/{target.scope}/{target.namespace}).

rolesanywhere_profile_includes_target.description: Target role is listed in an IAM Roles Anywhere profile ({target.rolesanywhere_profile_arn}, accepting {target.trust_anchor_arn}); dropped when the account's rolesanywhere_trust_anchor inventory is collected and empty, otherwise unknown (profiles not collected).

same_as_source.description: Target is the source itself (self-escalation); for entity kinds the source's own scope.

service_plane.description: aws_service_plane_admin: the managed service whose application plane is administered (amplifybackend|connect|grafana|quicksight|scn; IAM service prefix).

source_attached_policy_covered_by.description: A customer-managed policy attached to the source ({source.attached_policy_arn}) is covered by the action.

source_group_covered_by.description: Source is a member of an IAM group ({source.group_arn}) on which it holds the action.

source_kind.description: Technique only applies when the source principal is of this kind.

target_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): target node id (ARN / SA email / object id / cluster:ns:name) matches one of the case-insensitive globs (e.g. '*-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com', 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-reserved/*').

target_name_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): target display name (role / user / SA / identity name) matches one of the globs.

trust_allows_emr_containers_oidc.description: Role trusts an EKS OIDC provider with a sub condition on emr-containers-sa-* service accounts (EMR on EKS execution role).

trust_allows_federated.description: Role trust policy allows Principal.Federated equal to the value (e.g. cognito-identity.amazonaws.com).

trust_allows_oidc_provider_covered_by.description: Role trusts an IAM OIDC provider ({target.oidc_provider_arn}); the entry's requirements on that ARN carry the action.

trust_allows_principal_of_source.description: Role trust policy allows the source principal ARN, the source account (root/ID) or '*'.

trust_allows_principal_org.description: Role trust allows Principal '*' restricted by aws:PrincipalOrgID / aws:PrincipalOrgPaths, satisfied by an account of the snapshot's organization (unknown without the organization id).

trust_allows_saml_provider_covered_by.description: Role trusts a SAML provider ({target.saml_provider_arn}) on which the source holds the action.

trust_allows_service.description: Role trust policy has an Allow for sts:AssumeRole* whose Principal.Service includes the value.

trust_federated_provider_missing.description: Role trusts a SAML ('saml') or OIDC ('oidc') provider ARN of its own account that does not exist (iam_saml_provider / iam_oidc_provider inventory; unknown when not collected).

via_artifact_type.description: Target role's workload consumes an artifact ({target.artifact_arn}) of that type; artifact consumers are not collected (unknown).

via_assumable_role_attached_policy_cover.description: An assumable same-account role becomes admin after the source creates a default version of an attached customer policy.

via_assumable_role_covered_by.description: The source can assume a role on which it also holds the action (two-step self-escalation).

via_resource_type.description: Target role is attached to an existing resource of that type ({target.resource_arn}); lambda_function, ec2_instance, codebuild_project, glue_job, redshift_cluster, rds_db_instance, sagemaker_notebook_instance and redshift_serverless_workgroup are collected, other types are unknown when the role trusts the type's service (imagebuilder_pipeline: ec2.amazonaws.com).

action.description: ARM action (or dataAction with data_action: true).

bind.description: Requirements with the same bind name must hold on ONE common resource the source picks.

entra_catalog_role.description: Entitlement-management catalog role (display name or role definition id).

entra_group_member.description: Source is a (transitive) member of the Entra group (display name or object id).

entra_role.description: Entra directory role (name or template id).

fabric_workspace_role.description: Fabric workspace role at least as strong as this one.

scope.description: ARM scope / Entra directory scope ('*' = any).

any_of.description: Alternative groups: at least one group must fully hold (with all_of).

azure_member_user.description: Source is a directory user whose collected userType is Member; absent or Guest userType does not satisfy this selector.

include_service_managed.description: Allow service-managed identities (AWS service-linked roles, Google-managed agents, Microsoft first-party service principals) as sources; they are skipped by default because customers cannot act as them.

source_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): the source principal id matches one of the case-insensitive globs.

source_reaches_kind.description: Generic (evaluator, graph post-pass): the source is of that target kind or reaches a node of that kind through the other techniques' edges (fixpoint); the edge takes the weakest confidence of the best chain and the condition source_reaches_<kind>_via_chain.

any_principal_in_scope.description: Entity target covering every principal of the scope where the requirement holds (scope owner / cluster-admin / account admin).

attached_to_service.description: Identity is attached to a collected resource of that service (Lambda Role, EC2 instance profile, GCE/GKE service account, Azure resource identity incl. full ARM types). Uncollected attachment inventories fall back to trust/all identities with unknown confidence.

attached_to_vm_joined_to_entra_domain_se.description: Managed identity attached to a VM joined to a Microsoft Entra Domain Services managed domain (JsonADDomainExtension naming the domainName of a Microsoft.AAD/domainServices resource): conditional (domain_join_state_not_verified); other VM identities unresolved (manual joins leave no ARM trace) unless no managed domain is inventoried.

azure_aci_assignable_uami.description: The source can assign the exact user-assigned identity and write an inventoried ACI container group or create one in an inventoried resource group; missing inventory stays unresolved.

azure_aci_exec_running_identity.description: The exact native ACI container group carries the target managed identity, has a running container, and the source can execute a command there.

azure_aci_existing_write_identity.description: The source can update an exact existing running ACI group that carries the target managed identity; terminated groups do not qualify.

azure_acr_assignable_uami.description: The source can write a task on an inventoried ACR registry or existing task and assign an exact, verified user-assigned identity resource.

azure_acr_existing_task_identity.description: The exact inventoried ACR task carries the target managed identity and the source can write that task.

azure_aks_rbac_cluster_binding.description: The exact AKS cluster enables Azure RBAC for Kubernetes, and the source can authenticate to its Kubernetes API before creating a ClusterRoleBinding.

azure_aks_rbac_group_impersonation.description: The exact AKS cluster enables Azure RBAC for Kubernetes, and the source can authenticate to its Kubernetes API.

azure_apim_restorable_backup.description: One fresh reviewed record binds a valid APIM-created backup, storage access, compatible restore target, controlled policy, and the exact attached identity.

azure_appservice_assignable_uami.description: The source can assign the exact inventoried user-assigned identity to an existing app it can write and control code in, or create an app in an inventoried resource group using a joinable plan.

azure_appservice_backup_restore_code_pat.description: The source can restore a backup on the exact supported-tier App Service carrying the target identity; backup compatibility and code execution remain conditional.

azure_appservice_config_code_path.description: The target identity is attached to the exact app whose web or app-settings config child the source can write; the app's runtime must support a code-bearing configuration path.

azure_appservice_enable_publishing_crede.description: The source can enable the exact app's SCM basic auth policy and read its publishing credentials; the app carries the target identity and can run deployed code.

azure_appservice_kudu_code_path.description: The target identity is attached to the exact App Service for which the source holds publish/action, with a supported Kudu hosting plan and an app that can run.

azure_appservice_onedeploy_code_path.description: The source can write the exact app's extensions/onedeploy child; the attached identity belongs to that app, and its runtime loads deployed packages.

azure_appservice_publishing_credentials_.description: The source can read publishing credentials for the exact app carrying the target identity, SCM basic auth is enabled, and the runtime can load deployed code.

azure_appservice_sitecontainers_code_pat.description: The source can write a SiteContainer child of the exact Linux app carrying the target identity, and that app uses SiteContainers mode.

azure_appservice_siteextensions_code_pat.description: The source can install a site extension with a selectable package name on the exact Windows code app carrying the target identity.

azure_appservice_slot_code_path.description: The source has a code-bearing publish, source control, config, or SiteContainer route on the exact slot carrying the target identity.

azure_appservice_slot_publishing_credent.description: The source can read publishing credentials for the exact slot carrying the target identity, and that slot's SCM basic auth policy allows credential use.

azure_appservice_slot_swap_code_path.description: The source can stage code and swap the same inventoried slot into the exact production app carrying the target identity.

azure_appservice_sourcecontrol_code_path.description: The source can write the exact identity app's sourcecontrols/web child and that app can execute deployed repository code.

azure_arc_custom_script_code_path.description: The source can create or update a Custom Script child on the exact Arc identity machine while its connected agent permits that extension.

azure_arc_entra_admin_ssh_path.description: The source can read Arc relay credentials for the exact machine endpoint and log in as administrator through configured Entra SSH.

azure_arc_run_command_code_path.description: The source can create or update a Run Command child on the exact Arc identity machine while its connected agent permits the handler.

azure_assignable_via_identity_holding.description: User-assigned identity reached through an intermediate user-assigned identity T: the source holds Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/assign/action on T and T holds the named action on the target identity resource (e.g. an Image Builder template identity that assigns the build-VM identity). The edge takes the weaker of both grants and the condition via_intermediate_identity:<T>.

azure_assignment_condition_uses_principa.description: azure_scope_owner / azure_dataplane_admin targets covered by a role assignment of the source (or its groups) whose ABAC condition reads @Principal custom security attributes (scope owner: the role grants roleAssignments/write at that scope; data-plane admin: the role has DataActions over the resource). Conditional (attribute_value_satisfying_condition_not_verified).

azure_automation_assignable_uami.description: The source can assign the exact user-assigned identity to an inventoried Automation account or create one in an inventoried group, then create or edit and run a runbook there.

azure_automation_hybrid_worker_path.description: The source can create or edit and run a runbook on the Automation account with an inventoried Hybrid Worker VM carrying this identity.

azure_automation_runbook_identity_path.description: The source can create or edit and run a runbook on the exact Automation account carrying this managed identity.

azure_batch_job_pool_identity.description: The source can create a Batch job or schedule on the exact Entra-enabled account with a runnable native pool carrying this user-assigned identity.

azure_batch_pool_assignable_uami.description: The source can write an exact existing Batch pool or a new pool under an inventoried account and can assign the target user-assigned identity.

azure_batch_pool_starttask_identity.description: The source can write the exact native Batch pool that carries this verified user-assigned identity.

azure_batch_shared_key_pool_identity.description: The source can obtain a Shared Key from the exact Batch account with a native pool carrying this verified user-assigned identity.

azure_challenge_fact.description: Exact reviewed Azure technique/source/target/scope evidence; never a definite path.

azure_confidential_ledger_admin_path.description: The source has an Entra principal and the target is an inventoried usable Confidential Ledger whose ARM principal list can be updated.

azure_consumer_of_pivot.description: Managed identity of a workload that reads the pivot resource (value = binding kind(s): app_configuration_reference, event_subscription, key_vault_reference, queue_trigger, service_bus_trigger, storage_content). An identity holding the binding's read data action on a pivot resource is conditional (consumer_binding_not_collected); every other one is unresolved. Whether the consumer trusts the value enough to execute it is application logic: entries keep a condition for it.

azure_containerapp_assignable_uami.description: The source can write an exact inventoried Container App, attach the target user-assigned identity, and run a controlled revision.

azure_containerapp_create_uami_path.description: The source can create an app under an inventoried resource group and join an existing or creatable managed environment in the same subscription.

azure_containerapp_exec_identity.description: The source can obtain a console token and execute or debug on the same Container App with a running revision whose current identity is available to its main container.

azure_containerapp_job_assignable_uami.description: The source can assign the verified user-assigned identity to an exact writable job in a usable managed environment, or create a scheduled job in an inventoried group and joinable environment.

azure_deployer_of_pivot.description: Identity that deploys the pivot resource (e.g. deployment script runner); not collected (unknown).

azure_deployment_script_uami_path.description: The source can create or update a deployment script with the exact assignable UAMI and can manage its required support resources.

azure_external_plane.description: Exact adjacent authorization plane of a reviewed Azure external-principal gain.

azure_external_principal_evidence.description: Unique complete reviewed evidence binds a declared ARM action to one named adjacent-plane principal, usable credential or grant, prior denial, and a newly allowed target action.

azure_flux_cluster_path.description: A writable Flux configuration belongs to the exact AKS or Arc cluster and has cluster scope.

azure_host_linked_to_pivot.description: Identity of a VM linked to the pivot resource: avd_session_host (application group -> hostPoolArmPath -> session hosts), automation_hybrid_worker (hybrid runbook workers' vmResourceId), devtest_lab_compute_vm (lab VM computeId), service_fabric_node_vmss (not collected: always unresolved). Linked VM identities are derived; the others are dropped when every link under {pivot} is collected, else unresolved.

azure_identity_assignable_in_scope.description: Requirements with scope '*' must hold on a scope that contains the identity's attached resource (or the user-assigned identity resource).

azure_root_scope_only.description: Restrict an Azure root-scope authorization target to the tenant root (/).

azure_site_kind.description: Microsoft.Web/sites kind contains the value (functionapp, app, ...).

azure_storage_local_credential.description: Azure Storage SFTP local user credential; reset_password, write_credential, or create_credential. Requires exact account settings and verified container rights.

azure_users_assigned_to_pivot.description: azure_user targets holding Desktop Virtualization User (directly or through a group) on an AVD application group within {pivot}; always conditional (user_launches_app).

azure_vmss_instance_identity.description: The selected scale-set VM instance belongs to a scale set carrying this managed identity.

credential_stored_in_scope.description: Principals whose secrets are stored in that resource/scope (always conditional; secret contents are never read).

custom_role_assigned_to_source.description: Target scope is one where a custom role assigned to the source applies (role definition rewrite).

entra_access_package_auto_assignment_ope.description: Targets that are resources of an access package with an automatic-assignment policy whose rule does not exclude guests (userType -eq "Member"). Conditional (auto_assignment_rule_semantics_approximated).

entra_agent_blueprint_principal_or_child.description: Target is an agent identity blueprint principal or one of its child agent identities.

entra_custom_role_assigned_to_source.description: Target is reached by editing a custom directory role already assigned to the source.

entra_dynamic_rule_attributes_writable_b.description: Dynamic membershipRule references user attributes the source can write (membershipRule needed).

entra_dynamic_rule_satisfiable_by_invite.description: Dynamic membershipRule can be satisfied by a guest the source can invite (membershipRule needed).

entra_group_membership_cloud_writable.description: Synchronized or missing group source-of-authority facts keep a membership-write path conditional.

entra_group_membership_type.description: Group membership is 'assigned' or 'dynamic' (groupTypes contains DynamicMembership).

entra_group_source_self_membership.description: An application source needs Graph group-write and application-write permission to add its own service principal as a member.

entra_group_type_covered_by_permission.description: Group type (security / Microsoft 365) is covered by the entra_permission variant (groups.security / groups.unified).

entra_pim_eligible_for_source.description: Source has a PIM eligibility schedule for the target role.

entra_pim_group_eligible_for_source.description: entra_group targets for which the source (or one of its groups) has a PIM for Groups eligibility: true = member or owner, or 'member' / 'owner'. Always conditional (pim_activation_required).

entra_reset_matrix_column.description: Targets whose password the role column may reset per Microsoft's 'who can reset passwords' table, excluding role-assignable-group members and restricted-AU members.

entra_resource_in_catalog.description: entra_group / azure_service_principal / entra_role targets that are resources of an entitlement-management catalog; {target.catalog} = those catalogs (for entra_catalog_role requirements).

entra_role_assignable.description: Target is the named Entra directory role (display name, template ID, '*' or 'any').

entra_role_assignment_scope_covers_targe.description: The directory role assignment's directoryScopeId ('/', AU or object) contains the target.

entra_source_is_owner_of_application.description: Source owns the target's application object.

entra_source_is_owner_of_service_princip.description: Source owns the target service principal.

entra_sp_has_tenant_application.description: Service principal's appId belongs to an application registered in this tenant.

entra_sp_type_in.description: Service principal servicePrincipalType is one of the values.

entra_target_not_in_restricted_au.description: Target is not a member of a restricted management administrative unit (AU facts needed).

entra_user_upn_on_federatable_custom_dom.description: Target user's UPN is on a verified custom domain whose federation the source can change (domain facts needed).

exclude_target_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): drop targets whose node id matches one of the globs.

fabric_workspace_identity.description: azure_service_principal targets that are the workspace identity of a Microsoft Fabric workspace; {target.host_resource} = that workspace (for fabric_workspace_role requirements).

intune_managed_device_user.description: azure_user targets that are the primary user of an Intune-managed device. Conditional (device_session_not_verified): code run on the device reaches the user's session only while they sign in.

managed_identity_type.description: Managed identity is user_assigned or system_assigned.

ml_compute_assigned_to_source.description: Azure ML compute instance assigned to the source (not collected, unknown).

resource_permission_covers_target.description: The source must also hold this action on the target resource ({target.arn}/{target.email}/{target.scope}/{target.namespace}).

same_as_source.description: Target is the source itself (self-escalation); for entity kinds the source's own scope.

target_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): target node id (ARN / SA email / object id / cluster:ns:name) matches one of the case-insensitive globs (e.g. '*-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com', 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-reserved/*').

target_name_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): target display name (role / user / SA / identity name) matches one of the globs.

bind.description: Requirements with the same bind name must hold on ONE common resource the source picks.

any_of.description: Alternative groups: at least one group must fully hold (with all_of).

gcp_workspace_admin_role.description: Source is a Workspace/Cloud Identity user holding that admin role: 'super_admin' (users.isAdmin or a role with isSuperAdminRole) or an admin roleId / roleName (Admin SDK roleAssignments).

include_service_managed.description: Allow service-managed identities (AWS service-linked roles, Google-managed agents, Microsoft first-party service principals) as sources; they are skipped by default because customers cannot act as them.

source_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): the source principal id matches one of the case-insensitive globs.

source_reaches_kind.description: Generic (evaluator, graph post-pass): the source is of that target kind or reaches a node of that kind through the other techniques' edges (fixpoint); the edge takes the weakest confidence of the best chain and the condition source_reaches_<kind>_via_chain.

exclude_target_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): drop targets whose node id matches one of the globs.

gcp_actas_granted_on_target.description: Source holds iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on the target SA (SA policy or project/folder/org inheritance).

gcp_actas_granted_to_service_agent.description: Target SA is one on which the named Google service agent (cloudservices = Google APIs service agent <project-number>@cloudservices.gserviceaccount.com, used by managed instance groups) holds iam.serviceAccounts.actAs (SA policy or project/folder/org inheritance; Editor by default). Unknown when no binding of that agent is collected.

gcp_agentidentity_retrieve_path.description: Exact enabled Google OAuth provider and active authorization with useful granted scopes.

gcp_agentidentity_update_path.description: Exact enabled Google OAuth provider and active authorization whose later refresh could reach a changed token endpoint.

gcp_agentregistry_skill_evidence.description: Unique reviewed evidence ties a changed Agent Registry Skill to one floating consumer, runtime identity, and newly successful bounded action.

gcp_appengine_deploy_path.description: Existing App Engine application, source staging bucket, and target runtime service-account repository access.

gcp_appengine_instance_ssh_path.description: Exact flexible App Engine instance, backing VM, runtime identity, login method and SSH route.

gcp_appengine_legacy_actas_unenforced.description: Visible legacy App Engine actAs constraint with effective enforcement disabled for the target project.

gcp_appintegration_run_as_path.description: Enabled Application Integration service, one observed integration, same-integration invocation or publication rights, and actAs on the selected service account.

gcp_artifact_policy_consumer_path.description: Exact standard Docker repository, tagged Cloud Run consumer and runtime account, plus repository policy-write authority.

gcp_batch_agent_reporter_on_target.description: The target service account holds batch.states.report in its Batch job project.

gcp_bounded_access_gain.description: Unique reviewed evidence proves a newly allowed bounded action through one created or authorized intermediate resource.

gcp_bounded_mechanism.description: Exact indirect-access mechanism in the bounded-access evidence record.

gcp_bounded_service_execution.description: An enabled service account becomes a separate bounded service authority target for the named mechanism.

gcp_bounded_workspace_oauth.description: A named Workspace user becomes a scope-limited OAuth authority target for the named mechanism.

gcp_challenge_fact.description: Exact reviewed technique/source/target/scope evidence from gcp_privesc_challenge_evidence. Only verified preconditions produce a conditional path; missing or incomplete evidence is unresolved.

gcp_cloudbuild_writable_trigger_policy_p.description: An exact connection policy grant can self-grant repository token access for an enabled push trigger with a recorded build identity.

gcp_cloudbuild_writable_trigger_token_pa.description: An exact repository token grant is joined to an enabled push trigger whose repository build config and service account are recorded.

gcp_clouddeploy_configurable_custom_rend.description: Source can create or update an exact custom target and pipeline route, then create its release with the selected render account.

gcp_clouddeploy_custom_render_path.description: A collected pipeline stage, custom target, custom target type, and render service account are joined to exact update and release-create grants.

gcp_clouddeploy_existing_custom_render_p.description: A collected pipeline stage and custom target render account are joined to release creation on the exact pipeline.

gcp_clouddeploy_pipeline_policy_custom_r.description: A collected custom target render account is joined to setIamPolicy on its exact delivery pipeline.

gcp_cloudfunctions_create_path.description: Source can create a function with uploaded source and a known build account it can use, and can invoke it.

gcp_cloudfunctions_env_startup_path.description: Source can update an active Node.js 20 or later function, use its build identity, and reach an execution route.

gcp_cloudfunctions_existing_source_updat.description: Source can update the source of an active function, act as its build identity, and reach an observed invocation route.

gcp_cloudfunctions_source_deploy_build_p.description: Source can create or update a function built as an observed legacy Cloud Build default identity and can act as the function runtime identity.

gcp_cloudscheduler_authenticated_deliver.description: The project's Cloud Scheduler service agent has its required role for authenticated job delivery.

gcp_cloudscheduler_update_job_path.description: Source can update an enabled scheduler job, or update and resume a paused job, in the target service account's project.

gcp_cloudtasks_authenticated_delivery.description: The Cloud Tasks service agent has its project role and access to the exact target service account.

gcp_cloudtasks_enqueue_path.description: Source can create a task in a running queue, resume a paused queue, or create a new queue and task in the target account's project.

gcp_cloudtasks_queue_policy_path.description: Source can add task creation on an exact queue it does not already control, remove a target override when permitted, and dispatch from a running or resumable queue.

gcp_cross_project_cloudbuild.description: A build in another collected project can use the target SA only when the effective cross-project policy permits it and that project's Cloud Build service agent has token access.

gcp_cross_project_run_job.description: A Cloud Run job can be created and run in a different collected project with the target SA only when the target project's effective cross-project org policy permits it and its service agent has token access.

gcp_cross_project_run_service.description: A Cloud Run service can be created in a different collected project with the target SA only when the target project's effective cross-project org policy permits it and its service agent has token access.

gcp_cross_project_workflows.description: A workflow in another collected project can use the target SA only when the effective cross-project policy permits it and that project's Workflows service agent has token access.

gcp_custom_role_bound_to_source.description: Target is the exact scope where the source has a binding to a collected custom role, and the source can update that exact role.

gcp_external_plane.description: Exact external authorization plane named by the reviewed principal-gain record.

gcp_external_principal_evidence.description: Unique complete reviewed evidence binds a declared action to one named external-plane principal, usable credential, and a newly allowed target action.

gcp_gcr_namespace_path.description: Fully redirected gcr.io host with a missing matching repository, create and upload rights there, and an exact tagged workload consumer identity.

gcp_group_join_open_to_source.description: gcp_group targets the source can join without approval (Groups Settings whoCanJoin ANYONE_CAN_JOIN, or ALL_IN_DOMAIN_CAN_JOIN with the source's email domain equal to the group's; a source outside the group's domain also needs allowExternalMembers=true). Use with requires: {} and source_kind gcp_user.

gcp_hmac_storage_identity.description: Each enabled inventoried service account becomes a separate Cloud Storage-only HMAC authority target.

gcp_image_family_consumer.description:
gcp_service_account targets attached to a collected instance template whose boot disk sourceImage is an image family (projects/

/global/images/family/); {target.image_family_project} = projects/

of those families.

gcp_implicit_delegation_chain.description: Target SA is one a delegate chain can mint credentials for: the source holds iam.serviceAccounts.implicitDelegation on delegate D1, each Di holds implicitDelegation on Di+1 (transitively), and some Dk holds getAccessToken, signBlob or signJwt on the target. Delegates are not targets themselves (implicitDelegation does not yield their own token).

gcp_pam_entitlement_requester.description: Target scope has a Privileged Access Manager entitlement whose eligible requesters include the source (directly or through a group) and whose roles give IAM control of the scope. PAM entitlements are not collected (not evaluated).

gcp_resource_self_grant.description: A reviewed accepted self-grant or a modeled exact-resource policy write that adds a new permission; prospective resources include Secret Manager secrets, Cloud KMS keys, Pub/Sub topics and subscriptions, standard Artifact Registry repositories, and Analytics Hub exchanges and listings.

gcp_run_instance_create_or_update_path.description: Source can create a Cloud Run instance in the target project or update an exact existing instance there.

gcp_run_instance_ssh_path.description: Source has SSH permission on an attached Cloud Run instance that is running or can be started.

gcp_run_job_override_path.description: Source can run a collected Cloud Run job and override that same job's execution under its pinned service account.

gcp_run_job_policy_override_path.description: Source can set the IAM policy of a collected Cloud Run job pinned to the target service account.

gcp_run_job_update_execute_path.description: Source can update and run the same collected Cloud Run job in the target service account's project.

gcp_run_service_ssh_path.description: Source has SSH permission on an attached, ready second-generation Cloud Run service with SSH enabled.

gcp_run_service_update_path.description: Source can update an exact collected Cloud Run service in the target service account's project.

gcp_run_worker_pool_create_or_update_pat.description: Source can create a worker pool in the target project or update an exact existing worker pool there.

gcp_sa_in_scope_of_permission.description: Requirements with resource '*' must hold on the target SA's project (or the SA / an ancestor).

gcp_vertex_batch_prediction_path.description: Source can create a batch prediction job with an inline container and use a target service account delegated to the Vertex AI service agent.

gcp_vertex_new_model_endpoint_path.description: Source can upload a custom model, create an endpoint, deploy it, and use a target service account delegated to the Vertex AI service agent.

gcp_wif_active_path.description: An exact active workload pool or provider is joined to a pool-wide service-account token binding and the source's control action.

gcp_wif_restorable_path.description: An exact disabled or deleted workload pool or provider is joined to a pool-wide service-account token binding and the source's restore action.

gcp_workbench_existing_takeover_path.description: Source can update and boot the same existing Workbench instance or self-grant its instance administration rights.

gcp_workflows_observed_external_executio.description: An enabled Scheduler job is recorded to execute an exact workflow the source can update; other possible triggers remain unresolved.

gcp_workflows_update_attach_path.description: Source can update and execute an existing active workflow in the target service account's project.

gcp_workflows_update_execute_same_workfl.description: Source can update and execute the same active workflow attached to the target service account.

gcp_workforce_control_path.description: An exact workforce pool or provider control action is joined to an organization-local pool-wide service-account token binding.

gcp_workspace_super_admin_with_registere.description: gcp_workspace_user targets that are Workspace super administrators whose primary email domain is the domainName of a collected Cloud Domains registration; {target.domain_registration} = those registration resource names.

k8s_sa_has_token_secret.description: GKE: KSAs of cluster {target.scope} referenced by a kubernetes.io/service-account-token Secret (annotation kubernetes.io/service-account.name); joined from the related K8s snapshot, else one conditional aggregate per cluster.

k8s_sa_in_cluster.description: GKE: every KSA of cluster {target.scope}; joined from the related K8s snapshot, else one conditional aggregate per cluster.

k8s_sa_used_by_running_pod.description: Service account is used by a running pod with an available token.

resource_permission_covers_target.description: The source must also hold this action on the target resource ({target.arn}/{target.email}/{target.scope}/{target.namespace}).

same_as_source.description: Target is the source itself (self-escalation); for entity kinds the source's own scope.

target_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): target node id (ARN / SA email / object id / cluster:ns:name) matches one of the case-insensitive globs (e.g. '*-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com', 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-reserved/*').

target_name_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): target display name (role / user / SA / identity name) matches one of the globs.

bind.description: Requirements with the same bind name must hold on ONE common resource the source picks.

resource_match.description: any: any resource (and API group unless api_group is set) the rule names.

verb_prefix.description: Any rule verb starting with this prefix matches (e.g. 'impersonate-on:user-info:').

any_of.description: Alternative groups: at least one group must fully hold (with all_of).

eks_access_entry_type.description: EKS access entry type of the source EKS node-role cloud identity (related AWS eks_access_entry); sources whose entries have another type are dropped, sources without an entry are decided by the target selector.

include_service_managed.description: Allow service-managed identities (AWS service-linked roles, Google-managed agents, Microsoft first-party service principals) as sources; they are skipped by default because customers cannot act as them.

source_bound_to_aggregated_clusterrole.description: Source is bound to a ClusterRole with an aggregationRule: true = by any (Cluster)RoleBinding, 'cluster' = by a ClusterRoleBinding only (cluster-wide).

source_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): the source principal id matches one of the case-insensitive globs.

source_reaches_kind.description: Generic (evaluator, graph post-pass): the source is of that target kind or reaches a node of that kind through the other techniques' edges (fixpoint); the edge takes the weakest confidence of the best chain and the condition source_reaches_<kind>_via_chain.

any_principal_in_scope.description: Entity target covering every principal of the scope where the requirement holds (scope owner / cluster-admin / account admin).

azure_fic_matches_k8s_sa.description: Federated identity credential subject matches the SA (cloud facts needed).

exclude_names.description: Drop targets whose name is in the list.

exclude_target_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): drop targets whose node id matches one of the globs.

gcp_workload_identity_user_granted_to_k8.description: GSA grants roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser to the KSA member (cloud facts needed).

k8s_aggregated_rolebinding_namespace.description: The source is bound in the target namespace to a ClusterRole whose aggregationRule selects new ClusterRoles.

k8s_bound_role_gain.description: Collected Role rules contain a concrete permission the source lacks; the source can bind that exact Role in the target namespace.

k8s_clusterrolebinding_gain.description: A collected ClusterRole grants a new cluster-wide permission and the source can bind that exact role.

k8s_existing_clusterrolebinding_gain.description: An existing ClusterRoleBinding targets the exact ClusterRole and the source can modify that binding to gain a new cluster-wide permission.

k8s_existing_rolebinding_gain.description: An existing RoleBinding targets the exact Role, the source can modify that binding and bind the Role, and the Role grants a new permission.

k8s_helm_values_rbac.description: Reviewed exact ConfigMap-to-Helm-to-RoleBinding permission grant for the lab documented by the source.

k8s_node_cloud_identity.description: Cloud identity attached to the node (cloud facts needed).

k8s_node_hosting_host_mount_pod_in_names.description: Node hosts a pod of that namespace mounting a sensitive hostPath: a container runtime socket or a node credential path (even readOnly), or a host-executed path mounted writable; /etc/kubernetes, /home, /var/lib/docker|containerd and subPath mounts match conditionally. Other hostPaths (e.g. /var/log) do not match.

k8s_node_hosting_pod_of_source.description: k8s_node targets hosting a collected pod that runs as the source service account (the 'associated node').

k8s_node_hosting_pods_in_namespace.description: Node hosts pods of that namespace.

k8s_node_hosting_pods_with_sa.description: Service account is mounted by a scheduled pod (k8s_service_account) or node hosts pods (k8s_node); with a k8s_node source, the SAs of pods scheduled on that node.

k8s_node_hosting_privileged_pod_in_names.description: Node hosts a pod of that namespace with a privileged container (containers, initContainers or ephemeralContainers); added SYS_ADMIN / SYS_MODULE / DAC_READ_SEARCH / ALL, or SYS_PTRACE with hostPID, match conditionally. hostNetwork, hostIPC and hostPID alone do not match.

k8s_node_schedulable.description: Node can be targeted by direct pod placement with spec.nodeName even when cordoned; unconfirmed readiness is conditional.

k8s_nodes_mapped_to_cloud_identity.description: Nodes running with the source EKS node role (instance facts) that the role is mapped to: a node access entry (EC2_LINUX/EC2_WINDOWS) = derived, no entry = conditional (aws-auth mapRoles not collected; dropped in API-only authentication mode); not evaluated without the related AWS eks_access_entry inventory.

k8s_sa_absent_but_bound.description: Service account referenced by a (Cluster)RoleBinding subject but absent from the serviceaccount inventory (virtual SA node; anyone who can create it inherits the binding).

k8s_sa_cloud_binding.description: Cloud identity bound to the source SA via irsa|eks_pod_identity|gke_workload_identity|azure_workload_identity|aks_identity_binding (cloud facts needed).

k8s_sa_has_legacy_token_secret.description: ServiceAccounts referenced by a kubernetes.io/service-account-token Secret in their namespace (annotation kubernetes.io/service-account.name, from secret metadata; never data).

k8s_sa_in_namespace.description: Target service account namespace: '{source.namespace}', '{target.namespace}', '*', or a literal namespace.

k8s_sa_name.description: Target service account name is one of the listed names.

k8s_sa_named_in_scc_users.description: OpenShift: service account named in a SecurityContextConstraints users[] entry (system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<name>); SA nodes that only an SCC names are virtual (not in the serviceaccount inventory). Not OpenShift: no targets.

k8s_sa_namespace_absent.description: Service account referenced by a binding subject or an SCC users[] entry whose namespace is absent from a complete namespace inventory (creating the namespace and the SA inherits the reference).

k8s_sa_used_by_controller_managed_pod.description: Service account is used by a pod owned by a controller (ownerReferences).

k8s_sa_used_by_pending_pod.description: Service account of a collected pod in phase Pending with no spec.nodeName (unscheduled; a pods/binding or bindings write can place it on a node the attacker controls).

k8s_sa_used_by_pod_consuming_configmap.description: Service account is used by a running pod that consumes a ConfigMap (volume, projected volume, envFrom or env valueFrom; kube-root-ca.crt ignored); always conditional because execution of the content is not verified.

k8s_sa_used_by_running_pod.description: Service account is used by a running pod with an available token.

k8s_secret_holds_cloud_credential.description: cloud_identity targets standing for a static cloud credential stored in a Secret (one node per Secret, scope <cluster>/<namespace>, {target.name} = Secret name), recognised from Secret metadata only (name, labels, annotations: never data); value aws|gcp|azure|any or a list. Always conditional (content not verified).

k8s_secret_holds_remote_cluster_credenti.description: k8s_remote_cluster targets: Secrets whose labels match one 'key=value' (or 'key') selector; true = known markers (argocd.argoproj.io/secret-type=cluster, cluster.x-k8s.io/cluster-name with a *-kubeconfig name).

k8s_verified_pivot.description: Unique fresh reviewed evidence binds the exact source action and object to one accepted remote principal or newly granted Kubernetes permission.

kube2iam_namespace_permits_role.description: Namespace (usually {pivot.namespace}) annotation iam.amazonaws.com/permitted (kube2iam/kiam) allows the target role (annotation facts needed).

openshift_namespace_has_sa_with_host_scc.description: The OpenShift namespace (usually {pivot.namespace}) contains an SA allowed to use a host-level SCC (privileged / host PID / network / IPC / hostPath): from collected securitycontextconstraints users[] / groups[] and RBAC 'use' grants on security.openshift.io securitycontextconstraints. Unresolved when the SCC inventory or api_discovery is missing.

resource_permission_covers_target.description: The source must also hold this action on the target resource ({target.arn}/{target.email}/{target.scope}/{target.namespace}).

same_as_source.description: Target is the source itself (self-escalation); for entity kinds the source's own scope.

target_id_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): target node id (ARN / SA email / object id / cluster:ns:name) matches one of the case-insensitive globs (e.g. '*-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com', 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-reserved/*').

target_name_glob.description: Generic (evaluator): target display name (role / user / SA / identity name) matches one of the globs.

trust_allows_k8s_sa_oidc_subject.description: IAM role trust allows the cluster OIDC subject of the SA (cloud facts needed).

trust_allows_oidc_subject_wildcard.description: IAM role trust matches the given OIDC subject pattern (e.g. system:serviceaccount:{pivot.namespace}:*) on the cluster OIDC provider (cloud facts needed).

conditions.description: Documented caveats (not machine-checked; never change confidence).

grants.description: Permission / role names the outcome yields (documentation).

outcome.description: application_admin: Becomes administrator of a managed service's own application plane (not an IAM principal).; blocker_removal: Lifts an enforcement control (target.removes_blockers) that gates other techniques; reaches no principal.; bounded_authority: Evidence-bound effect on the exact non-principal target, defined only by the rule and verified facts; implies no IAM scope control, application administration, principal access, or further permissions.; credentials: Obtains credentials / tokens / a session of the target principal (keys, passwords, tokens, AssumeRole).; identity: Becomes the target principal (mechanism unspecified).; impersonation: Acts as the target through a delegation/impersonation API without holding its credentials.; membership: Becomes a member of the target group and inherits its grants.; permission_grant: The source's own permissions grow (policy/role edit or assignment); target is self or an entity.; role_activation: Activates/assigns a privileged role or permission set (PIM, Identity Center, Entra directory role).; scope_control: Gains IAM control of a scope (set IAM policy / role assignments) -> every principal of the scope.; workload_execution: Runs code inside a workload that carries the target identity (passed role, attached SA/MI).

removes_blockers.description: k8s_admission_control: blocker ids the technique lifts.

description: A catalog YAML file is a list of techniques (or, for _excluded*.yaml, a list of {source, reason}). Generated from peaso/privesc/schema.py; cross-field rules are enforced by validate_entry.
title: Cloud privilege-escalation technique catalog file
